heroHeadline: Day 9,004 of America's Longest War — Op Ghazab Day 97; Pakistan-China Urumqi Process Consultations; Russia Mediation Offer; 28-Day Strike Pause; Jawid Niazi Day 27; UNICEF: 90% Afghan Children in Food Poverty
heroSubtitle: June 2, 2026 marks Day 9,004 since the US launched Operation Enduring Freedom. Day 97 of Pakistan's Operation Ghazab lil-Haq continues with no confirmed cross-border airstrikes for a 28th consecutive day. Pakistan Special Representative Mohammad Sadiq met Chinese Envoy Yue Xiaoyong in Islamabad to discuss the Urumqi Process — the most substantive Pak-China engagement on the Af-Pak track since Round 1 ended April 7. Russia offered to mediate between Pakistan and the Taliban following the May 27-28 Military-Technical Cooperation Agreement, though no response from Islamabad has been reported. Paigard News Agency director Jawid Niazi enters Day 27 in Taliban GDI custody — no bail, no charges, no legal access. Eid al-Adha 2026 is expected June 5-6 pending Saudi moon sighting, with TTP's 3-day ceasefire days from activation. Faryab province saw Taliban detain Uzbek community members following interethnic protests. UNICEF reports 90% of Afghan children in food poverty, half in severe food poverty — a record crisis as WFP's $313M funding gap for 4.9M mothers and children remains unaddressed.
